trial_court: III Addl. Prl. Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru, M.C.No.543/2010
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2007 and have a son born in 2009. The respondent alleged the petitioner was unhappy with the marriage and picked quarrels for silly reasons. The petitioner left the matrimonial home voluntarily on 20.02.2007 and started living with her parents.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking a decree of divorce to prove that the other party has neglected them.
legal_principles.held: Under the circumstances, as rightly contended by the learned Counsel for the appellant, the question of asking the parties to this appeal to stay together and lead a married life would not arise

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking a decree of divorce must prove that the other party has neglected them.
legal_principles.held: The respondent had approached the Family Court seeking a decree of divorce under Section 13(1)(ia) & (ib) of the Act

outcome.final_order: The appeal is filed against the judgment and decree dated 07.04.2015 passed by the trial court, allowing the petition filed under Section 13(1)(ia) & (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act.

keywords: Latin Maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
